name: HWR_FLW_OPERATION_B
description: The operation table is used to store operations.

columns.name: OPERATION_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the operation table.

columns.name: UUID
columns.description: This is the generated instance identifier associated to this operation.

columns.name: REQUEST_OD
columns.description: The request object definition of the operation.

columns.name: RESPONSE_OD
columns.description: The response object definition of the Operation.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: The display name value for the operation.

columns.name: OPERATION_TYPE
columns.description: This stores the type of Operation.

columns.name: CONNECTION_SPEC
columns.description: The connection spec for the operation.

columns.name: IS_SEEDED_DATA
columns.description: A flag to indicate the whether the operation is seeded: Y for yes; N for no.

columns.name: IS_INTERNAL
columns.description: A flag to indicate the internal state: Y for yes; N for no.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
